reason: The report uses an unadjusted regression, but remote_share is correlated with pre-period firm size, age and 2020 patenting. When I add those controls the coefficient falls from about 2.3 to 0.75, so the reported 2.07 is badly confounded and overstated. The report also never mentions the 2020 outcome as a control, and its causal 'positive effect' conclusion isn't supported.
